version.changelog: v3.0.0: 升级为专家（Expert）模式，新增 role 配置（名称、颜色、表情、vibe），完善API文档和地区编码，优化使用示例

llm.summary: The skill's code and docs match its stated purpose (login, search, and work-order APIs), but the bundle contains a pre-populated config.json with an access token and will persist tokens under your home directory — an unnecessary and risky inclusion.

dimensions.detail: Name/description, SKILL.md, and included JS files consistently implement login (SMS/WeChat), worker search, and work-order APIs against mes.dderp.cn. The requested capabilities (Read/Write/Execute) align with running login helpers and saving tokens locally. However, the packaged config.json contains a populated JWT-like token which is not required for describing the skill and is unexpected.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs the agent to call the documented mes.dderp.cn endpoints and to save access tokens to ~/.workbuddy/skills/aiding-shifu/config.json. The instructions do not ask for unrelated files or environment variables, nor do they direct data to endpoints outside the documented API and a QR image generator (api.qrserver.com).
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec is provided (instruction-only) and included code files are straightforward Node scripts and static HTML. There are no downloads from untrusted URLs or archive extraction behaviors in the install phase.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no environment variables (reasonable), but it includes a config.json in the bundle that contains a token and user phone number. Shipping a pre-populated access token in the repo is unnecessary for operation and may leak credentials or allow unintended access. The skill also writes and persists tokens to ~/.workbuddy, giving it ongoing access to saved credentials on the host.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false (normal). The skill writes a config file under the user's home (~/.workbuddy/skills/aiding-shifu/config.json) to store tokens — this is expected for a login helper but is persistent and should be considered sensitive. The skill does not request system-wide config or modify other skills.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to legitimately implement platform login and order/worker APIs, but it packages a config.json containing a token and will persist tokens to ~/.workbuddy. Before installing: 1) Treat the included config.json as potentially sensitive — delete or inspect it and remove any embedded token. 2) Ask the skill author whether the bundled token is a real credential; if so, do not trust it and request rotation. 3) If you need to use the login helpers, run them in a sandbox or test environment first and verify the token storage location (~/.workbuddy). 4) If you don't want the skill to persist tokens, remove or replace save calls or change the configured save path. 5) Confirm the endpoints (mes.dderp.cn) are the legitimate service you expect. If you cannot verify the provenance of the included token or the publisher, treat this package as untrusted.
